summary: Check out all the new features of our latest website update! Be inspired and easily find products that fit your requirements. Read more here.
title: A Tour Of Our New Website
bodyHtml:
You spoke and we listened. With your feedback we’ve made a raft of changes, removed things that weren’t useful and generally made our website more intuitive and easy to use!

Watch our quick video below to explore our new and improved features to help you get inspiration for your next bathroom project, while making it easier than ever to find the perfect products for your specific requirements.

View original embedded media

Now you can enter your postcode to easily find our products on display close to your home or office!

Search our collections for products that fit your particular needs - Locate products by size, shape, style and retail price!

Our new & improved bathroom guides and inspiration is jam packed full of ideas, style guides and recent projects we've been a part of. 

If you’re thinking of renovating or looking to choose the right products for your new bathroom, you can be sure that you’ll be up to date with the latest trends in bathroom style as well as learn about some of the more technical considerations necessary for successful design.

If you’re an architect, developer, builder or want to specify an assortment of Studio Bagno products for your next bathroom project, our new Project Manager feature allows you to add our products to a project sheet, so you can download and submit to get project indicative pricing on our whole collection as well as get access to exclusive project products only available to professionals.

Sign up to create an account and check the "Architects, Developers" box before hitting submit. Once approved, you'll be able to access our exclusive professionals only range, allowing you to add them to your project quotes.

Every 6 months, we release an updated version of our Black Book Collection, which is our all-in-one definitive catalogue, price list and technical manual. You can grab your free copy in an electronic version immediately or get a gorgeous hard copy version in the mail by inputting your info into the form.

We are excited to share our new website experience with you to help you create your perfect bathroom. Take it for a test drive yourself by hitting below:

 

Explore Studio Bagno
